svg.title: Kernel run execution and recovery
svg.desc: The Agent records a request, launches a per-run driver, streams model responses, applies policy, records tool intent before executing a tool, and projects every appended event. Approvals and restart recovery use the same ledger-driven loop.

text.tspan: → Run.Apply + wake status waiters → notify observers
Run is input-required, policy approval releases the driver
File ledger fsyncs non-idempotent intent before the call
Questions, progress, and connection waits also emit events
Restart: rebuild status, idempotency keys, and child references from the ledger.
Resume unfinished runs through the same driver. Pending approvals wait.
Retry an unanswered model request or an idempotent tool.
Other interrupted tools need approval, except supported continuations / connection waits.

svg.text: Launch one driver, acquire root-run slot
Check allowlist, loop guard, call limits
Projected run status or ledger event stream
